propositions: On final exhaustion of the prompted reask loop in _pai_structured, when llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir is set to a non-empty path, write a timestamped artifact containing the raw reply text, model id, contract name, and attempt count to that directory before raising the last validation error.

The config key llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir is resolved in LLMConfig.from_env via _llm_str with REBAR_LLM_PARSE_FAILURE_ARTIFACT_DIR env alias and None default; unset (default) preserves today's behavior byte-for-byte with no writes.
Artifact writes are best-effort and never mask the original parse error; I/O failures (missing/unwritable dir, disk full) are swallowed and the error is raised unchanged.
Successful parses take the return path and write nothing; only the final failure seam before raise last triggers the artifact hook.
Retention is by count: after writing, prune oldest-by-mtime artifacts so at most 20 remain per directory to prevent unbounded growth on unattended hosts.
